description: Player avatar system: avatar base, equipment fit and declaration, avatar pack, portraits, composer
deviation_notes: Owner decisions of 2026-10-01 recorded in the spec. Phase 3: the fit bounds rule became a show-through rule; pauldrons on the upper arms; shields on hand.L; base clips aim held items. Rollout: 138 equip blocks, 122 pass; 16 pieces moved to rework; the shield socket moved outward and lower; gloves and gauntlets need a closed-fist shape. 2026-10-02: all 12 fit reworks are ready (7.0 or more, fit ok); no catalog row is rework. Three displays moved onto y = 0 with their origins (cape, plate-armor, boots). 2026-10-04: capped hair done; hair styles moved to their own slot `hair` (a style stays under a hat); open pieces (circlet, crown, bandana) keep the full hair (`fullHair`).
